content: EDRM Processing Guidelines treat NIST-list filtering (de-NIST), hash deduplication, family relationships (parent/attachment), email threading, near-deduplication and exception reporting as distinct processing steps; de-NIST removes known system files by hash, dedup compares hashes across the collection, near-dup catches same content in different formats (DOCX vs PDF), exception reports list items that failed processing. Cross-checked across EDRM, Everlaw and Duke Judicature.
